premise: A deep-space salvage crew finds a derelict that remembers them
tone: quiet space-horror on a working salvage ship: blue-collar literary science fiction, close and claustrophobic, where the dread is recognition rather than monsters; tired, tender, exact about the work, and unsettled by a thing that knows the crew by name

chapters.title: Right Berths
